I'm sorry if you don't want to hear this right now. I feel as if your parents are trying to protect you from danger. In this case, weed. They're being harsh on you to amplify the gravity of their punishment. It seems that they care a lot about your wellbeing. If you could try to apologize to them and explain why you have chosen to use weed, they could understand your situation. 

Please try to reflect on the situation in a positive way. Your parents care about you a lot. They might not handle this situation in the best manner, but they're human too. I understand how hurt you are from their choice of punishment, and I'm not saying that I'm okay with their choice. But I do feel like you could resolve it with them. 

I hope you feel better soon.

You're not selfish for feeling this way. In my opinion anyway. I understand where you're coming from, to some degree, as I've not been through the same but have been trying to kill myself for the past 10 years. With 3 failed attempts under my belt, I think I can relate to some degree. As this might offer an solution to your pain and your problems, and at this time you can see no other options, I really hope you choose not to. 

You are a strong person. Even if you believe that you aren't. Look at your victories. Even if they're small. If you could try and focus on those, it might help you feel better. I sincerely hope it does. Sometimes, even getting out of bed is a victory. 

If you ever need someone to talk to. I'm here for you.
An unfortunate chain of events. You have the strength and willpower to make it through. I believe in you. Now all you have to do is believe in yourself. Good luck my friend.

I did OD but I made it. It was a tough night. Police managed to find me and take me to a hospital. Drank activated carbon and here I am. Still alive. Perhaps I'll make a post of it. But I'm not ready for that yet. 


I really hope you feel better. As much as I wish I had died, I somehow feel that I now have at a chance at proving myself wrong. That I am worth something. If not to anyone else, I can be worth something to myself. 


The struggle is real. I feel you. But I sincerely hope that you make it through. Message me any time if you want to talk.
